title: Introduce horizon guard and deferred credit ramp for tenant fallback credits
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: During recent regional capacity events we observed fast oscillation between tenant fallback and recovery that caused excessive KV cache thrashing and transient SLO violations for mid-tier customers. This PR introduces two coordinated mechanisms: (1) a Horizon Guard (time-windowed, metric-anchored circuit buffer) that prevents aggressive reopen attempts for tenants that have recently been failed over, and (2) a Deferred Credit Ramp that hands out fallback/soft-degrade credits to tenants incrementally over a warmup window instead of a single-step allotment. Goals: reduce reopen oscillation, stabilize KV cache pressure, and smooth latency impact on medium-priority tenants while preserving graceful degradation semantics. Changes are conservative and opt-in via config flags per-region and per-tenant.

release_notes:
- Add Horizon Guard to reduce tenant reopen oscillation and stabilize KV cache under regional stress.
- Introduce Deferred Credit Ramp to distribute fallback credits over a warmup window for smoother degradation.
- Opt-in per-region and per-tenant via config flags; default disabled in region defaults.
- New telemetry and dashboards for Horizon Guard state and ramp progress.
notes_for_ops: Deployment: feature flags off by default. To enable in a region: set region_defaults.horizon_guard.enabled to true and tune deferred_ramp.window_ms. Watch new metrics horizon_guard.state_changes/s and deferred_ramp.allocations/s. Rollout recommendation: enable in a single canary region for 24h, observe kv_pressure.p50/p95, reopen_attempts.rate, and tenant_latency.p95 before broadening.
backport_suggestion: Backport recommended to release/2026-02 for customer incidents tied to reopen storms; changes are guarded by flags to minimize risk.
manual_migration_steps: Run scripts/upgrade/2026-02-deferred-credit-migration.sql to populate tenant_ramp_state for existing tenants if migrating to enabled state. If rollback required, unset region_defaults.horizon_guard.enabled and run migration rollback script in same directory.
